lines.text: The girl stares intently at Marian as she lies there, seemingly asleep.
She closes her eyes and focuses her mind. She doesn't sense anyone nearby.
The girl's body becomes engulfed in black.
Moments later, the blackness spreading from her swallows the entire area.
The blackness envelops Marian as well.
The girl opens her eyes.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Hi, sleeping girl.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Do you feel better now?

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Are you still scared?
Marian stares intently at the girl.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: No. I'm fine now.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... I want to be absolutely sure.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: This is inside your mind, right?

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Uh-huh. You're outside, sleeping right now.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: So we can only talk here.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... That's incredible... Is this what a Queen is capable of?

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: I dunno.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: You're a Queen too, right?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Yes. That's right.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: But right now... I'm not really sure.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: What...

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: What does a Queen have to do?

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: You know...

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: My heart keeps pounding.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: I feel like it keeps telling me to do something.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: I know I can become a Queen, and a Queen has to do something.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Has to. Doesn't have a choice.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: But... what do I need to do?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I... I don't know.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: What did you want to do?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I wanted to create a world where everyone could love one another.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: A world where Nikkes, humans, and Raptures could all love one another.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... But it didn't work out.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Why did you want to do that?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Well... obviously because...

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Because I wanted to... protect everyone...

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Everyone? Nikkes, humans, and Raptures?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... Yeah.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: How?

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: You're so greedy.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... I'm greedy?

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Yeah. I get scolded everyday.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: They tell me not to eat so much and to eat just enough for my body.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: They say I'm greedy.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: But I can eat it all. So I do.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: I'm not greedy.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: But you are.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Ah, someone's coming.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Bye. See you later.
*Whirr*

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: There you are.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: What are you doing here, Little Sister?
Why are you calling her that?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Since she's Master's daughter, that makes her my little sister.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yes. We should get the titles right.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I suppose that makes her Anis's niece, then? Hehe.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Har har. Very funny.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Mommy. Mommy. Hug me.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: All right, come here.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Um... I can hug you. I'm probably a bit more cuddly, you know.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I don't like you.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Huh...? Why not...?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: You threw a star at me.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: No... that was... er...

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: That's right. We don't like people who hurt us, do we?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Then can I hug you?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Uh-huh. Hug me.
Neon takes the child into her arms.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Wow. This is more stressful than I thought. I'm afraid I might drop her.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: It's okay. Just let your maternal instincts take over.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I'll do my best.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: *Snores*

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Huh. She fell asleep.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I guess she likes you.
Everyone's gaze falls on the sleeping child.
We savor the peaceful moment for a brief moment, but soon turn our eyes to Marian lying there.
She remains completely motionless.
Marian. We're here.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: The whole Counters Squad is here.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: So please, wake up already and give us a big hug.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Come on, hurry up.
Rapi looks down at Marian, who lies there with her arms spread open.
... As expected, Marian doesn't move an inch.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... This isn't working.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Should we try dancing around her?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: What, like some kind of a rain dance or something? Why don't you just play some music instead. How about "Be My Star?"

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: The Tetra legal team might come after us for illegal advertising. Maybe we should splash some water on her.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Getting her body wet could cause all sorts of problems. How about waking her up with the smell of food?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Are we trying to hunt a wild animal or something? It's better if—

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Rather than that, we should—

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: No, forget all that. We need to—
As everyone spouts all sorts of bizarre ideas in hopes that Marian will wake up...
I keep my eyes on Marian.
I imagine Marian opening her eyes as if nothing had happened and greeting us.
Then, I feel a gaze from somewhere.
The child cradled in Neon's arms opens her eyes and looks right at me.
She stares at me intently, as if observing me.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Daddy.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: ... Hmm?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Is the sleeping girl someone special to Daddy?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: How special?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Well... it's hard to put into words.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Do you want her to wake up?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I'll think about it a little longer.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Huh? About what?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I'm not telling.
The child hops down from Neon's arms and dashes away.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: ... What was that about?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Who knows? You can never really tell what kids are thinking.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Hehe. She's so adorable.
Meanwhile, in the present...
After landing near the Lift, we take a look around.
... It's really quiet.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: ... Damn, the comms...

lines.speaker: cecil_op_c
lines.text: The jamming is way stronger than expected.

lines.speaker: papillon_op_r
lines.text: Really? Even after all those upgrades to the auxiliary facilities?

lines.speaker: cecil_op_c
lines.text: This is no good. Let's set up more. As many as we can.

lines.speaker: papillon_op_r
lines.text: Give me a break. It may look easy, but you have no idea how hard it is for me to fly around...

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: Hurry up.

lines.speaker: papillon_op_r
lines.text: ... Fine. I'm on it.
Johan, Cecil. Do you copy?
It's not working. Communications are completely cut off.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: ... I don't recall it being this bad.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: The last time we were here, communications were fine until Mirror showed up.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Are you saying Mirror might be nearby?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: That might be the case, but I think the cause is over there.
I look in the direction Leviathan is pointing.
Bizarrely writhing black pools can be seen everywhere.
... Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It's everywhere. There's so much of it.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: They probably took it all from our home. Hmm.
Leviathan reaches out and points at the Dark Matter pools.
A moment later...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... No. I've completely lost control of it.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It's not responding at all.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: What are you doing, playing psychic?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Could you try bending my glasses?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It's completely ignoring my commands.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Just like you're ignoring us.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: ... It must be the Queen.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Yeah. It's safe to assume the Queen has control over all the Dark Matter in this area.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... Has it found its master?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Its master?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I've always believed that the Queen is the source of the Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: The fact that the kid was able to manipulate Dark Matter more skillfully than I could from the moment she was born...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Not to mention, I believe the Queen invaded our home to acquire the Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: ... Liliweiss's body was formed from Dark Matter, too.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Yes. Considering everything, all the evidence points to the Queen being the source of the Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Needless to say, she doesn't just handle it skillfully, she wields it as if it's an extension of her body.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Er... s-so, in the worst-case scenario...

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Y-you're saying even the Dark Matter we're currently wearing or using could be stolen from us?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander. If that happens, the Four Beasts might end up being the Four Naked Beasts.
Why are you looking at me when you say that...?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: That shouldn't be a problem. The Dark Matter we all have is practically one with us already.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It's already finished transforming and is no longer in its original form. We'll be fine.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Probably.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: O-okay... if you say so. I believe you, Levi.
Then let's get moving.
We'll get as close to the Lift as possible and assess the situation.
Then we hit them with everything we've got before retreating.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: All right. Let's go.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Mirror, or the corrupted Nayuta, could show up at any moment.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: And the Heretics, too.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Proceed with extreme caution. But don't lose your nerve.
Just as we are about to move out...
A flash of light erupts from one side of the Lift.
And then, something massive bursts out.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: That's...!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: A H-Heretic Missile! That's Annihilio, right?!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: It's heading... towards the Ark!
